verdict: screened (a LABELLED 4-JOINT OPTION, 4 active joints, never the lead): Bench(110,360) exact frozen chain-only gate 10.54 (score 96.17), plain 9.94, reach 0.8056 (290/360), overhead 13/28 (lead 8), elev 90-140 55/85, 2 contacts (T5 14.74 mm), 2 mm reading 23.30 (lead 34.84, pick 1 47.00); pre-registered gates: pass <= 13.75 chain-only yes; connected overhead >= 12/28 yes; ring-added overhead takes under 2 mm <= 2 yes; held overhead >= 25/71 yes. Step 1 (short knee keeps 261/262 lead takes, follow 1.0) and step 2 (distal shell parked costs 0 gate points: 18.90 = chain-only; shell in-band 1.0; 0 shell-torso contacts at delta 0) pass. vs pick 1 (9.75): better in-band (0.894 vs 0.890) and 2 mm (23.30 vs 47.00), worse contacts / reach at the imported IK table. RED TEAM (own, new): the ARM-FIXED shell sits in the torso on 30 of 360 ws poses the chain does not close (plane 90-150, IR -105..-180, to -11.9 mm, along the whole arc), unscored by the bench's closing-pose convention; counted as contacts the gate reads 17.48. The same convention applies to pick 1 / phi40 (unmeasured there).
limiter: (1) the fold: the abduction cone stays shut (J1 / J2 seat-level wall, the ring cannot reach it) and the stretched-fold IR overhead poses close at no k in [0, 40]; (2) the ANTERIOR shell end meets the torso at the hanging-IR posture: the measured cap at s 118 is ~+47-49 deg from the pad azimuth (delta 0 puts the end at +46.8, 1.04 mm clear at pose 460; delta 3.5 -> -1.37 mm on 5 ws + 2 clip; delta 12 -> -10.55), so the travel cannot grow anteriorly and the IK rides the slot end; (3) ring-made contacts at k 25-40 on IR poses plane 90-150 (cause: hardware). (4) the arm-fixed shell meets the torso on 30 non-closing across-body IR poses (to -11.9 mm): a round shell at s 118 is too large in radius on the medial-anterior side for deep IR; the measured window between the hanging-IR anterior cap and the across-body posterior contacts is narrower than the 55-deg arc.
